target: Everything the chosen Windows PC route and Wii-exclusive cleanup offer, spoiler-free

areas.name: Windows PC Run Setup
areas.location_cue: The profile and difficulty screens before beginning the Berlin campaign.
areas.note: Use the Windows PC release for the full campaign; the Wii-only cleanup appears later in this pack.

save_backup.title: Back up the profile before score-focused runs
save_backup.why: Mission scores are reduced after repeated saves, while quick saves disappear after leaving a map or closing the game.
save_backup.detail: Keep an external copy of the profile before attempting clean War Record scores; ordinary completion remains replayable through mission selection.

items.label: Complete the campaign on Sniper Elite difficulty

levels.1: Choose the game's most demanding named preset for the main run.
levels.2: Select Sniper Elite on the difficulty screen before starting the Windows campaign.
levels.3: Create a normal profile, choose the Sniper Elite preset, and clear every campaign map without switching to Custom. This is Sami's chosen difficulty and exposes the full wind, gravity, posture, heart-rate, and enemy-pressure model.

levels.1: Treat saving as part of a clean performance attempt.
levels.2: Finish one mission while using no more than six manual and quick saves combined.
levels.3: Start from a backed-up profile and count every manual save and quick save. The first six do not reduce the mission score; each later save applies another ten-percent reduction. Quick saves also vanish when the map ends or the game closes, so make a normal save when continuity matters.

levels.1: There is one presentation option that makes the hardest simulation stricter.
levels.2: Replay a completed mission with maximum ballistics and Instant Scope/Binoculars disabled.
levels.3: Use the Sniper Elite preset or matching maximum simulation values, turn Instant Scope/Binoculars off, and finish a map with six saves or fewer. The slower view change raises the scoring potential; Custom settings cannot submit to the discontinued online ranking, but the local War Record still records the run.

areas.name: Meet the Informant
areas.location_cue: The opening ruined suburb with a dry riverbed, roadblocks, and damaged houses.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Move patiently through the first streets and check each new objective before leaving.
levels.2: Reach the contact in the northern ruin, free the captive in the western building, take him south, then use the marked exit.
levels.3: Stay near cover while crossing the riverbed and avoid drawing either roaming tank. Enter the contact's ruined building by its upper slope; afterward, reach the guarded western room from the northeast, clear it, escort the freed fighter to the southern safehouse, and follow the final marker out.

areas.name: Supply Raid
areas.location_cue: A battered district containing two pillboxes, an ammunition position, and armored roads.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: The friendly assault only advances after both defensive positions are quiet.
levels.2: Clear both pillboxes from their flanks, cover the friendly demolition team, then defeat the armored counterattack.
levels.3: Circle around each pillbox rather than crossing its firing lane, eliminate the crews, and hold the overlooking position while the friendly unit moves through. Cover its attack on the parked armor, then destroy the arriving tank and accompanying troops; TNT placed on its road and shot from safety is the reliable tank solution.

areas.name: The Reichstag
areas.location_cue: The monumental government complex surrounded by camps, trucks, a rear statue, and an anti-aircraft position.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Keep the opening infiltration quiet and inspect the back of the complex before leaving west.
levels.2: Enter without an alarm, sabotage the marked trucks, collect the dead-drop beneath the rear statue, clear the anti-aircraft position, and exfiltrate west.
levels.3: Use the fighting around the perimeter as cover but do not trigger the compound alarm. Reach each marked truck and destroy it, then circle to the statue behind the main building and take the hidden intel at its base. Eliminate the anti-aircraft crew and nearby defenders before following the western exit marker.

levels.1: The perimeter can be crossed without alerting the garrison.
levels.2: Reach the interior objective zone before any alarm is raised.
levels.3: Stay outside searchlights and patrol sightlines, use the surrounding battle noise for suppressed movement, and silently remove only guards who block the marked approach. Restart the map if the compound alarm sounds before the entry objective completes.

areas.name: Brandenburg Gate
areas.location_cue: The broad avenue and landmark gate beside cellars, drains, wrecks, and a waiting vehicle route.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Prepare the marked meeting ground before taking the decisive shot.
levels.2: Meet the OSS contact, reach the wine cellar through the damaged drain, prepare the half-track, complete both target opportunities, then reach the escape vehicle.
levels.3: Collect the SVT-40 from the contact and enter the cellar through the broken drain. Place TNT beside the half-track, withdraw to a protected sightline, and shoot the charge when the marked group gathers. Confirm both marked targets are down, then leave through the route leading to the waiting extraction vehicle.

levels.1: The primary shot can also settle an optional target nearby.
levels.2: Wait until both marked targets are within the half-track blast area.
levels.3: Do not fire as soon as the primary marker appears. Let both marked figures move beside the prepared half-track, shoot the TNT bundle, and verify both objective confirmations before heading to extraction; reload the pre-shot save if only one registers.

areas.name: Missing Contact
areas.location_cue: Elevated railway ruins overlooking a bridge, nearby streets, and a hidden supply position.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Hold the high ground long enough to make a safe route across the district.
levels.2: Secure and defend the bridge position, visit the hidden ammunition cache, inspect the last-known location, and reach the new rendezvous.
levels.3: Clear the bridge approaches from the elevated S-Bahn position and remain there through the counterattack. After the defense objective confirms, follow the green marker to the concealed ammunition cache, then inspect the indicated room for the note that updates the route. Continue to the newly marked northern rendezvous.

areas.name: Meet the Courier
areas.location_cue: A guarded street network with ruined rooms, armored patrols, and a northern meeting point.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Search the marked meeting place carefully before moving toward the square.
levels.2: Reach the northern rendezvous, collect the route note there, and continue to the square exit.
levels.3: Avoid the armor by using the interiors and side streets, then search the full marked rendezvous area rather than leaving when it appears empty. Pick up the note that identifies the truck route, and follow the updated marker toward the square to finish the map.

areas.name: Infiltrate the Square
areas.location_cue: The outer streets and cellars surrounding a heavily guarded formal square.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: A quiet takedown and one carried body open the route forward.
levels.2: Meet the contact, silently take down the marked officer, carry the body to the cellar, then leave toward the cathedral.
levels.3: Reach the OSS contact without starting a general firefight. Find the marked senior officer beneath the rooftop sniper's position, use the silenced P38 from behind, pick up the body, and return it to the contact's cellar. Drop it inside the objective zone, then follow the exit marker toward the cathedral.

areas.name: The French Cathedral
areas.location_cue: The walled square dominated by a damaged cathedral and its southeast tower.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: The tower is both the observation point and the key to the escort sequence.
levels.2: Enter the cathedral walls, climb the southeast tower, trigger the signal, protect the marked runner and truck, cross the western ruins, and exfiltrate.
levels.3: Enter through the broken passage beside the body in the outer ruins, clear the route to the southeast tower, and climb to the objective vantage. Use the prompted signal, then shoot every pursuer threatening the marked runner or transport. When the truck departs, traverse the western ruined buildings and follow the final exit marker.

areas.name: Exfiltrate the Square
areas.location_cue: Streets south of the square leading through ruins to a concealed hideout.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Slow the search before committing to the final hiding place.
levels.2: Collect the emergency supplies, defeat enough pursuers to complete the delay objective, then reach the southern hideout unseen.
levels.3: Take the resistance supply cache at the start, use mines and short ambushes to thin the pursuing patrols, and move after each shot. Do not enter the final building until the delay objective confirms; once it does, break line of sight and follow the southern marker into the hideout.

areas.name: Karlshorst Reprise
areas.location_cue: The fuel depot revisited at night, with searchlights, towers, pumps, valves, and a command hut.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Two long-fuse charges should be placed before the marked arrival.
levels.2: Infiltrate along the western edge, plant bombs on the fuel valve and pump control, obtain the codebook from the commander, and exit through the tunnel.
levels.3: Avoid the searchlight towers and use the western platform lip to reach the first white bomb outline; set a long fuse there. Continue through the ditch to the second marked control and set its fuse several minutes shorter. Wait near the command hut, silently eliminate the commander after arrival, search the body for the codebook, then crawl to the exit tunnel before the charges detonate. Never crawl beneath a burning tank.

areas.name: Secure U-Bahn Station
areas.location_cue: A riverside elevated station with a bridge, radio post, square, and several sniper perches.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Clear beyond the station itself; the final defenders are spread toward the square.
levels.2: Eliminate the station defenders, inspect the radio post, clear both bridge approaches and the square, then use the exit marker.
levels.3: Shoot the exposed vehicle fuel cap from the opening building, remove the snipers above the bridge and far bank, and clear the station rooms. Use the radio inside to collect the document and update the objective. From the upper floor, clear the bridge and distant roofs, sweep the square until the objective completes, and head to exfiltration.

areas.name: Prevent Reinforcements
areas.location_cue: A street approach overlooking a refueling convoy and a commander near parked trucks.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: The convoy becomes much harder to stop if its commander escapes.
levels.2: Destroy the opening tank, reach the sniper position, eliminate the commander, destroy the transport trucks, recover the papers, and return to the exit.
levels.3: Shoot the opening tank's fuel cap from cover and clear its escort. Move through the left-hand ruins to the indicated firing position, identify the commander beyond the leftmost truck, and take that shot first. Use grenades on the nearest transports, clear the remaining troops, search the commander's body for the papers, and return to the origin-side exfiltration marker.

areas.name: Anhalter Station
areas.location_cue: A large rail terminal with benches, platforms, roof access, and incoming transport routes.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Quietly remove the near guards before preparing the station ambush.
levels.2: Clear the station perimeter without a warning call, prepare the arrival route, stop the incoming unit, and preserve the rail equipment if possible.
levels.3: Use the benches to block sightlines while silently removing the first patrols, then enter the station and place trip mines on the approach routes. Take the roof position, destroy the escort trucks by shooting their fuel caps, and eliminate the survivors crossing the traps. Do not damage the train or tracks unless the mission is otherwise failing; finish with both intact for the cleanest outcome.

levels.1: The rail equipment is a fallback target, not the preferred solution.
levels.2: Stop the incoming unit without sabotaging either the train or the rails.
levels.3: Build the ambush with trip mines on infantry paths and shoot the road vehicles from the roof. Keep explosives away from the locomotive and track bed, and confirm the mission ends with neither fallback sabotage action used.

areas.name: Via the U-Bahn
areas.location_cue: A descending station and long underground rail tunnel ending at a narrow service passage.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Clear the platforms in layers and keep a close-range weapon ready below ground.
levels.2: Fight down to the tracks, follow the tunnel through each guarded room, and reach the service exit.
levels.3: Eliminate the opening sniper, clear the station floors, and descend to the tracks. Follow the only rail route, remove the distant sentry, and use the mounted weapon if the tunnel patrols push forward. Take an MG42 for the rooms ahead, silently remove the lone guard behind the left door, grenade the next three-man room, and continue clearing the narrow route to the exit.

areas.name: Approach to Nordsig
areas.location_cue: A residential district and park leading toward an industrial perimeter.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: One command position can be removed before crossing the park.
levels.2: Reach the command post, eliminate its commander and guards, cross the park, and enter the plant perimeter.
levels.3: Advance between ruined cover toward the marked command headquarters and eliminate the commander before he can bring more troops into the area. Clear his nearby guards, cross the playground and park, and either bypass the tank or destroy it with thrown TNT shot from cover. Continue to the industrial exit marker.

levels.1: The command post is worth clearing before the final approach.
levels.2: Eliminate the marked commander inside the headquarters before passing the park.
levels.3: Approach the headquarters before moving toward the plant, identify the marked commander through the openings, and take him out before the area becomes fully alerted. Clear the room so the objective confirmation appears, then resume the route across the park.

areas.name: Eliminate Guard Post
areas.location_cue: The south gate and truck courtyard outside the heavy-water plant.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Use the vehicles outside, but keep explosives away from the protected industrial structures.
levels.2: Silently enter the south gate, destroy both courtyard trucks, clear the guardhouse and sniper, then use the rear plant entrance.
levels.3: Remove the first sentry inside the south gate with the silenced pistol. From cover, shoot the fuel tanks on both courtyard trucks to break the main defense, then eliminate the guardhouse occupants and rooftop sniper. Search the post for ammunition and follow the waypoint through the rear door; do not throw explosives toward the control room or storage tanks beyond.

areas.name: Nordsig Heavy Water Plant
areas.location_cue: Three connected industrial buildings surrounding a courtyard, control rooms, large tanks, a safe, and a radio room.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Work through all three buildings; several objectives send you back to earlier rooms.
levels.2: Secure the control area, breach the marked steel door, operate the tank valve, obtain the safe combination, open the safe, use the radio, and reach the roof stairs.
levels.3: Clear Building 1 and cross the courtyard without destroying the supply truck. In Building 2, place a timed charge on either outlined steel door and wait at a safe distance; enter Building 3, clear the control area, and operate the master drainage valve beside the large tanks. Return to Building 2, confront the marked officer to obtain the safe combination, go back to Building 1 and open the guarded safe, then use the radio room. Finally return to Building 2 and climb the long staircase to the roof.

areas.name: Assist OSS Team
areas.location_cue: The plant roof overlooking two gates, adjacent rooftops, a courtyard, and an armored approach.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Prioritize the vehicle blocking the friendly advance, then scan the skyline.
levels.2: Clear both gate approaches, destroy the tank from above, eliminate the rooftop snipers and ground group, and hold until the objective confirms.
levels.3: Go prone at the roof edge and first clear the troops covering both entrances. When the tank presents its rear or side, shoot the external fuel-drum cap; use TNT only if it never exposes that point. Sweep the surrounding roofs for the elite snipers, then keep clearing the ground attackers until the friendly unit reaches the compound and the objective-complete message appears.

areas.name: Exfiltrate Nordsig
areas.location_cue: Dark streets and a park route returning toward the U-Bahn entrance.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: The direct exit is available, but three marked sniper positions are worth clearing first.
levels.2: Meet the alley contact, collect the Mosin-Nagant, eliminate all three elite snipers, then return to the U-Bahn exit.
levels.3: Move through the park shadows and circle the block to the marked alley. Take the Mosin-Nagant from the contact, then follow each of the three sniper waypoints in turn; scan rooftops from prone cover and relocate after every shot. When all three optional confirmations appear, avoid or clear the remaining patrols and enter the U-Bahn marker.

levels.1: Three distant threats sit away from the shortest exit route.
levels.2: After the alley meeting, visit all three sniper waypoints before entering the U-Bahn.
levels.3: Equip the newly collected Mosin-Nagant, move to each waypoint, and search the upper windows and rooflines rather than the streets. Confirm one objective update per sniper; entering the station first ends the chance for this run of the map.

areas.name: Cut Communications
areas.location_cue: A field headquarters connected to three outward roads used by motorcycle couriers.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Trap the roads before approaching the headquarters itself.
levels.2: Stop all three motorcycle couriers, eliminate the headquarters commander, and use the exfiltration marker.
levels.3: Follow the southern street and place trip mines across the first courier route, then repeat on the western road while keeping a rifle angle on any gap. Confirm all three motorcycles are stopped before leaving the sector. Throw grenades into the field headquarters or clear it directly to eliminate the marked commander, then proceed to exfiltration.

levels.1: The couriers are required; their coordinator is an extra target.
levels.2: Clear the field headquarters after stopping the three motorcycles.
levels.3: Once all courier counters are complete, approach the headquarters from cover, use grenades through its openings, and verify the commander marker clears. Do this before touching the exfiltration zone.

areas.name: Destroy Ammo Dump
areas.location_cue: A fortified supply district containing a radio, transport trucks, and two ammunition depots.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Clear the communications point before placing the demolition charges.
levels.2: Destroy the radio transmitter, sabotage the transport trucks, plant charges at both ammunition depots, and exfiltrate.
levels.3: Remove the sniper facing the start and survive the initial assault from cover. Follow the first marker to the radio and disable it, then shoot the fuel tanks of the marked transport trucks. Clear each depot, place a timed bomb only on its white objective outline, leave enough fuse to reach the exit, and confirm both depot counters before entering exfiltration.

areas.name: Disable Katyushas
areas.location_cue: A circular meeting area connected to a pilot position and two guarded rocket-battery sites.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Finish the rescue route before demolishing every launcher.
levels.2: Meet the local commander, retrieve the stranded pilot, return him safely, destroy all four rocket launchers, and follow the train-yard marker.
levels.3: Reach the commander in the central circle, then clear the patrols and rooftop sniper along the pilot marker. Interact with the pilot and escort him back before moving on. At each of the two battery sites, clear the defenders and destroy both launchers with a timed bomb or TNT, giving four confirmed launcher destructions in total; only then continue toward the train yard.

areas.name: Holzmarkt Train Yard
areas.location_cue: Two large warehouses and a central rail courtyard containing tank cars and fuel storage.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Both warehouse clearances and both fuel targets count before the exit opens cleanly.
levels.2: Clear the first warehouse, destroy its marked fuel target, sweep the courtyard and second warehouse, destroy the second fuel target, then exfiltrate.
levels.3: Crawl to the first warehouse, remove its guards from the lower floor upward, and place a timed bomb at the outlined fuel tank. Cross the middle courtyard only after clearing its patrols, repeat the full sweep in the second warehouse, and destroy the second rail-car fuel tank. Wait for both demolition confirmations before following the exit marker.

areas.name: The Schloss
areas.location_cue: A walled estate crossed by eastern and western bridges and a convoy road.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Prepare the main road and protect the intact vehicles during the two-sided defense.
levels.2: Meet the western-bridge leader, preserve the convoy trucks, destroy the tank and attacking groups at both bridges, then secure the far side.
levels.3: Before the defense starts, lay spaced trip mines and TNT on the main road without blocking the friendly trucks. Meet the marked leader at the western bridge, then fire only on hostile troops and never on the convoy vehicles. Shoot the tank's external fuel point or your road charge, destroy the reinforcement truck before it unloads, and alternate between both bridges until every attacking group is down. Cross to the far-side objective only after the area-clear confirmation.

areas.name: Extract the Pilot
areas.location_cue: A convoy road, observatory complex, and street route leading to a transport rendezvous.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Prepare the road first, then clear the observatory before beginning the escort.
levels.2: Ambush the convoy, reach and clear the observatory, return to the marked pilot, escort him with follow/stay commands, and reach the exit.
levels.3: Place two trip mines across the convoy route, move behind the expected stopping point, and eliminate the guards after the lead vehicle hits the trap. Follow the new marker to the observatory, clear the outside from range, and search the upper floor. Return to the pilot, stay close enough for the interact command, alternate Follow and Stay while clearing each block, and lead him into the final transport zone.

areas.name: Journey to Tempelhof
areas.location_cue: A stranded truck at a street junction surrounded by several approaches and two roaming tanks.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Protect the truck first; chase the armor only after the infantry wave is finished.
levels.2: Defend every street leading to the truck, defeat the full commando wave, destroy both tanks and their escorts, then return to the vehicle.
levels.3: Immediately place at least two trip mines across each road into the truck junction, adding extra traps on the tank-facing streets. Stay near the vehicle until the infantry-defense objective completes, replacing mines with those found on bodies. Then lure each tank over a thrown TNT bundle, shoot it from cover, clear the remaining escorts, and return to the truck marker.

areas.name: Tempelhof Airport
areas.location_cue: Two large hangars, a control tower, fuel storage, a radar van, and an open taxiway.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: Keep the hangars quiet, then use the tower to control the final defense.
levels.2: Silently clear the hangars, sabotage the fuel depot, take the control tower, eliminate both radar operators, stop the reinforcements, and reach the moving aircraft.
levels.3: Use the P38 while prone to remove the machine-room guard and the two hangar sentries without an alarm. Crawl through the far eastern hangar to the fuel depot and set a five-minute timed bomb, then return and assault the control tower. From above, kill both operators at the radar van in quick succession, destroy incoming trucks before they unload, and cover the taxiway. When the aircraft moves, stay out of its path, sprint behind it, and interact at the boarding point.

levels.1: A distant demolition point can distract the final assault.
levels.2: Reach the fuel storage beyond the eastern hangar before attacking the tower.
levels.3: After silently clearing the three hangar sentries, crawl out through the far eastern door, pass behind the radar van, and place a timed bomb at the marked fuel storage. Use roughly a five-minute setting, retrace the same concealed route, and begin the tower assault before it detonates.

areas.name: The Safehouse
areas.location_cue: A hotel block with a restaurant entrance, stairways, upper rooms, roof access, and a second building down the street.
areas.note: Complete this map on Windows PC after the campaign unlock; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: This post-clear map begins quietly, then asks you to prepare the entire building.
levels.2: Reach the hotel contact, defend the building for the full timer, escort the contact through the street, and enter the final safehouse.
levels.3: After the main campaign clear, move past its final entry in Mission Select to reveal this map. Sneak north into the hotel and meet the contact, then place trip mines across the main entrance, restaurant door, lower stair, and upper stairs. Defend from the roof and corridor until the five-minute task confirms, return to the contact, turn right outside the main door, and advance one block at a time while keeping the escort clear of grenades. Enter the marked building together.

areas.name: Flak Tower
areas.location_cue: The Wii mission's ruined approach, radio post, nearby safehouse, tower perimeter, and half-track route.
areas.note: Complete this map on the Wii release through Dolphin; finish every objective before using the exit marker.

levels.1: This extra map belongs to the Wii port and must be handled as a separate cleanup.
levels.2: Launch the Wii release in Dolphin, enter the mission through Single Player, disable the radio post, meet the squad leader, and cover the half-track ambush.
levels.3: Use a legally dumped Wii copy in Dolphin and create the case-sensitive profile name reb00 if mission selection is not already open. Choose Flak Tower under Single Player; it does not appear in the cooperative list. In the map, infiltrate the outer ruins, destroy the radio post before approaching the safehouse, meet the marked squad leader, then take the indicated overwatch position and eliminate the guards around the arriving half-track until the rescue objective and mission-complete message both register.

items.label: Destroy the radio post before the rendezvous

levels.1: Quiet the nearby communications position before meeting the squad.
levels.2: Clear and destroy the radio post in the outer ruins before entering the safehouse marker.
levels.3: From the starting approach, follow the radio objective into the ruined outer position, eliminate its defenders, and interact with or destroy the marked radio equipment. Wait for its confirmation before continuing to the safehouse; doing this first reduces the alert pressure during the later ambush.

areas.name: Arsenal and Field Tools
areas.location_cue: The inventory strip and weapon pickups available throughout completed campaign maps.
areas.note: Use each stock weapon and field tool at least once on Windows PC; these are equipment experiences, not persistent unlocks.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Fire the starting semi-automatic sniper rifle during any campaign map.
levels.3: The Gewehr 43 is available from the beginning. Fire a scoped shot, compensate for wind and drop on Sniper Elite difficulty, reload its five-round magazine, and finish the encounter so the weapon has been fully sampled.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Collect the alternate semi-automatic rifle during Brandenburg Gate and use it there or later.
levels.3: Meet the OSS contact near Brandenburg Gate and take the supplied SVT-40. Use its four-power scope for at least one confirmed long-range hit; its rounds drop more than the Gewehr 43, so hold higher at distance.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Collect the bolt-action rifle during Exfiltrate Nordsig and use it before leaving.
levels.3: Meet the alley contact during Exfiltrate Nordsig, pick up the Mosin-Nagant, and use its six-power scope against one of the three optional snipers. Work the bolt after the shot and account for its heavier drop and wind drift.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Take an MP40 from a German soldier or a placed pickup and fire it in close quarters.
levels.3: Search a downed German soldier in detail or take a placed MP40, equip it as the secondary weapon, and empty part of its magazine during a close-range fight. Reload once to experience its slower, controllable automatic fire.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Take a PPSh-41 from a Soviet soldier and use its drum magazine.
levels.3: Search a downed Soviet infantryman, equip the PPSh-41, and fire a sustained burst before reloading its drum. Its high rate is best demonstrated against a close group where precision sniping is unnecessary.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Pick up the pan-magazine machine gun from an appropriate heavy gunner or cache.
levels.3: Find a DP-28 on a heavy Soviet gunner or weapon cache, equip it, and complete one firefight with it. Fire a controlled burst and perform a reload so its pan-fed handling is represented.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Collect an MG42 in the U-Bahn route or from a German machine gunner.
levels.3: A reliable pickup appears during Via the U-Bahn after the tunnel rooms. Take the MG42 with spare ammunition, use its very high fire rate on the next guarded passage, and reload it once.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Use a single-shot German anti-armor pickup against a vehicle.
levels.3: Collect a Panzerfaust from a marked cache or enemy position, aim at the rear or side of an armored vehicle, and fire from outside its blast zone. The launcher is disposable, so confirm the hit before moving on.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Use the reusable anti-tank launcher when a campaign cache supplies one.
levels.3: Take a Panzerschreck from a weapon cache, fire it into the weaker side or rear of a tank, and stay clear of the blast. Confirm the vehicle is destroyed; unlike the Panzerfaust, this launcher can accept another rocket when ammunition is available.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Use the starting suppressed pistol for an undetected takedown.
levels.3: Equip the P38, approach an isolated guard from behind, and fire one close head shot while no other guard has line of sight. Move or hide the body before its discovery so the suppressed use remains genuinely stealthy.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Search a Soviet officer or enter a LAN match to handle the unsuppressed pistol.
levels.3: In single player, perform a detailed search on a Soviet officer until a Luger P08 is available; it is also the multiplayer sidearm. Equip it and complete one close-range engagement, remembering that it does not provide the P38's suppressed advantage.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Use the Soviet fragmentation grenade against a clustered patrol.
levels.3: Select the fragmentation grenade, hold the throw control to choose the landing point, release it into a group, and retreat beyond the blast. Confirm at least one target is affected.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Use the long-throw German grenade on a defended room or position.
levels.3: Select the M24, use its longer throwing reach to place it through an opening or behind cover, and move back before it detonates. Confirm the guarded position is cleared.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Throw a TNT bundle, retreat, and detonate it with a rifle shot.
levels.3: Select TNT, throw it beside a stationary vehicle or into a patrol route, withdraw at least thirty metres, and shoot the bundle. If the setup is poor, pick it up before detonation and place it again.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Place a timed charge on a white demolition outline during a sabotage mission.
levels.3: At a marked demolition silhouette, place the timed bomb and choose a fuse from one to thirty minutes. Leave enough time to clear the site; unlike TNT, rifle fire will not set it off, but it can be picked up and reset before detonation.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Stretch a tripwire across a route used by infantry or a light vehicle.
levels.3: Place the first stake beside the route, back away to stretch the wire, and place the second stake on the opposite side. Lure an infantry group or light vehicle through it, while remembering that the player and moved bodies can also trigger the mine; it is not strong enough for a tank.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Perform one silent melee takedown on an isolated guard.
levels.3: Crouch or crawl behind an unaware guard, equip the knife, and use it at close range. Move the body into cover before another patrol notices it.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Use a stone to redirect an unalerted patrol.
levels.3: Select a stone, throw it away from the intended travel line, wait for the unalerted guard to investigate, and pass behind or silently remove that guard while attention is diverted.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Use a bandage after taking partial damage.
levels.3: Allow only light damage, select a bandage from the inventory, and use it to restore part of the health display. Save med-packs for larger damage so both recovery items can be demonstrated.

levels.1: Try every distinct piece of field equipment at least once during the completed campaign.
levels.2: Use a med-pack after taking substantial damage.
levels.3: After the health display has lost a large portion, select and use a med-pack to restore it fully. Do not spend it on a trivial wound that a bandage can cover.

areas.name: LAN Multiplayer Modes
areas.location_cue: The Windows multiplayer menu reached from the title screen through LAN Game.
areas.note: Official internet matchmaking is unavailable; use two Windows PCs on a LAN or a private virtual LAN for the stock modes.

levels.1: Try the free-for-all rules in a private LAN session.
levels.2: Host Deathmatch for at least two players and reach a finite score or time limit.
levels.3: On one PC choose LAN Game, Create, and Deathmatch; set a small nonzero score or time limit and enable any stock map. Join from the second PC, score through kills or the selected dogtag rule, and finish the round in first place.

levels.1: Try the two-team rules and avoid friendly-fire penalties.
levels.2: Host Team Deathmatch, place players on opposing teams, and reach the team score limit.
levels.3: Create a LAN Team Deathmatch with a finite limit and at least two players. Score against the other team through kills or dogtags as configured, avoid damaging teammates, and let one team reach the victory condition.

levels.1: This mode changes roles across rounds, so experience each side.
levels.2: Host Assassination with enough rounds for every player to become an assassin once.
levels.3: Create a LAN Assassination match, set Number of Rounds per Player to one or more, and enable exfiltration. As an assassin, eliminate the marked target, collect the dogtag, and reach the extraction zone; as a bodyguard, complete a round by keeping the target alive or eliminating all assassins.

levels.1: The server setup screen can rotate the complete stock map set.
levels.2: Use Map Setup to include every map shipped with the Windows release.
levels.3: Open the LAN server's Map Setup page, note every stock map shown by the installed release, enable the full list, and play at least one completed round on each. Do not count downloaded community maps toward this stock-set requirement.

areas.name: Profile-Name Secrets
areas.location_cue: The Create New Profile name field on the main-menu profile screen.
areas.note: Test these only after the legitimate campaign and score runs; each secret profile records zero mission score.

levels.1: One case-sensitive profile name changes every rifle impact.
levels.2: Create a profile named Panzer and fire a rifle shot in any mission.
levels.3: Create a separate profile with the exact name Panzer, start a mission, and shoot a safe target to see the explosive-rifle effect. Do not use this profile for score completion because its mission score remains zero.

levels.1: Another case-sensitive profile name removes rifle report noise.
levels.2: Create a profile named Stealth and fire near an unalerted patrol.
levels.3: Create a separate profile with the exact name Stealth, begin a mission, and fire the sniper rifle close enough that an ordinary shot would be heard. Observe the silent-rifle behavior, then leave this zero-score profile outside the legitimate completion run.

levels.1: The strangest profile secret affects a small ambient animal.
levels.2: Create a profile named Ratbomb, find a rat, and shoot it from a safe distance.
levels.3: Create a separate profile with the exact name Ratbomb, load a map containing rats, stand clear of nearby hazards, and shoot one to trigger the hidden explosion. Mission scores on this profile remain zero.
